platform.title: Everything a building asks of you, in one place.
platform.copy: Immevia brings a building’s maintenance, finances, documents, meetings and communications into one space — with a memory that grows with every action.

areas.title: Maintenance and requests
areas.text: Residents report a problem from their phone, with photos and availability. You assign a contractor through a personal link — no account on their side — and they accept, set the visit, submit their quote, their “after” photos and their invoice. Every step shows on the case thread, and the invoice becomes an expense in one action.

areas.title: Living Record
areas.text: Insurance, contracts, studies, certificates, plans: every document is a dated piece of evidence attached to a component of the building. What expires is flagged before the deadline; what is missing is listed. The record stays when the board changes.

areas.title: Finances
areas.text: Common expenses, payments received, expenses with receipts, advances and repayments. Interac e-Transfers received by e-mail are recognized and matched automatically; late payments trigger courteous reminders with a direct sign-in link for the resident.

areas.title: Meetings
areas.text: Notice, agenda, attached documents, attendance replies, reminders, assisted session (attendance, quorum, majorities), minutes generated and sent. Obligations voted go into the schedule.

areas.title: Communications and portal
areas.text: Every resident has their portal — installable on the phone like an app — with their requests, their statement, the building’s documents and notices. Sign-in by e-mail link, no password to remember.

platform.exceptionTitle:

record.title: Your building’s memory, that doesn’t leave with the people.
record.copy: A board changes, a manager leaves, a contractor closes shop. What they knew about the building disappears with them — unless something held on to it. That is the Living Record: a file that builds itself with every intervention, every document, every decision.
record.whatCopy: Every item in the record is attached to a component of the building (roof, heating, insurance, contingency fund…), carries a validity date and knows what it proves. When a new policy replaces the old one, the old one is archived — not lost, not mixed up.

sections.title: Reference documents
sections.text: Declaration of co-ownership, by-laws, plans, studies, certificates, insurance policies — with their expiry date when they have one.

sections.title: Interventions
sections.text: Every resolved maintenance request leaves a trace: who came, when, for what, at what price, with the before and after photos.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.text: What was voted at the meeting, when, with which majority — and the obligations that follow, in the schedule.

sections.title: To follow up
sections.text: What is missing, what is expiring, what is planned: a short list sorted by urgency, rather than a binder to leaf through.

sections.title: Requests to professionals
sections.text: Need a contingency-fund study or a maintenance log? Immevia prepares the request to the professional with the relevant documents, then files their report as evidence.

sections.title: Document recognition
sections.text: A photographed receipt, an invoice received by e-mail: the platform extracts the essentials and suggests where to file it. You confirm.

record.howTitle: You don’t have to fill it in. It fills itself in.

how.title: You manage as usual
how.text: A maintenance request, a payment received, a meeting held: every everyday action leaves its trace in the right place of the record.

how.title: Documents arrive through the usual channels
how.text: A forwarded e-mail, a photo taken on the phone, an upload: Immevia recognizes the type of document and suggests the component and the date. You validate.

how.title: The record speaks to you
how.text: Every week, what expires or is missing shows up under “To follow up”. The rest stays quiet.

how.title: It survives change
how.text: New board, new manager: they inherit the complete record, with the history and the evidence, from their first sign-in.

record.honest: The Living Record organizes information and its deadlines. It replaces neither the maintenance log prepared by a qualified professional, nor the contingency-fund study, nor legal advice — it files them, dates them and reminds you when they must be renewed.
record.metaDescription: The Living Record: dated evidence attached to each component of the building, expiries flagged ahead of time, a history handed over to the next board.

cta.title: Start your building’s record.
cta.text: It builds up over the weeks. The sooner it starts, the more it will be worth.

assemblies.title: From the notice to the minutes, without chasing anyone.
assemblies.copy: The annual meeting is where everything gets decided — and, for many syndicates, the most painful moment of the year. Immevia takes care of the logistics from start to finish, so you can focus on the decisions.

flow.title: Prepare
flow.text: Date, place, agenda, attached documents (financial statements, budget, quotes). Immevia gathers what is already in the record: you don’t have to hunt for the documents.

flow.title: Send the notice
flow.text: One e-mail per unit, with the agenda, the documents and a direct sign-in link to the portal. You receive a test copy first to check how it looks.

flow.title: Track attendance
flow.text: Each co-owner replies in one click from the e-mail: attending, represented, absent. You see who hasn’t replied and remind them with one tap — without retyping a message.

flow.title: Hold the session
flow.text: Session mode on a tablet or computer: attendance confirmed, quorum computed from the fractions, each item voted with the required majority displayed. Proxies are recorded.

flow.title: Produce the minutes
flow.text: The minutes are generated from what was entered during the session, in the expected format, then sent to the co-owners. They are filed in the record.

flow.title: Keep decisions alive
flow.text: An obligation voted (work, special assessment, by-law change) becomes a schedule entry with its date: it doesn’t stay buried in the minutes.

syndicats.copy: You’re a volunteer, you have a life, and yet the fees have to come in, the roof has to be fixed, the meeting has to be held and the documents have to be where they should be when someone asks for them. Immevia was built for exactly that first — by someone who manages his own co-ownership.

faq.title: What people ask us before getting started.
faq.copy: Straight answers. If yours is missing, write to us.

items.q: How long does it take to set up a building?
items.a: One evening for the basics: the building, its units, its residents (name, e-mail, phone). Documents and history are added over the following weeks — the Living Record is designed to build up gradually, not to be filled in one go.

items.q: Do residents have to install anything?
items.a: No. They receive an e-mail with a link that signs them in directly, no password. On a phone, the portal can be added to the home screen like an app in two taps. A password remains possible for those who prefer one.

items.q: What about co-owners without an e-mail address?
items.a: You can enter things on their behalf (meeting attendance, maintenance request, payment by cheque). They appear in the record like everyone else; they simply don’t receive the automatic e-mails.

items.q: Can we bring in our Excel history?
items.a: Past payments and expenses can be imported from a CSV file (exported from your spreadsheet or your bank statement). Existing documents upload in batches and the recognition suggests where to file them.

They don’t create an account. When you assign them a job, they receive a personal link (by e-mail, or by text if you copy it) that opens a page with the request, the photos and the resident’s availability. There they accept, set the visit, submit their quote, “after” photos and invoice. The link stays valid for the duration of the job.
The syndicate manager or property manager only. Residents see the progress of their request (contractor assigned, visit scheduled, work completed) and the photos, never the amounts.

Fees are posted every month. Interac e-Transfers received at the syndicate’s e-mail address are recognized and matched automatically; whatever isn’t recognized is presented to you for one-click matching. Late payers get a courteous reminder with a direct sign-in link, at the cadence you choose.

Notice with attached documents, one-click attendance replies, reminders to those who haven’t replied, assisted session (attendance, quorum, majorities), minutes generated and sent, decisions added to the schedule. The full flow →

The database and the documents are hosted in Canada (Montréal region). Some processing — the application servers, e-mail delivery, automatic document recognition — takes place in the United States with established providers. The full list is in our privacy policy (in French).

Each person sees only what belongs to their role and their building: a resident sees their unit, a board member sees the building, a contractor sees their job. Documents are served through signed, time-limited links, never a public address. Every action is logged.

items.q: Can we get our data back if we leave?
items.a: Yes. Your documents, monthly reports and minutes are files you can download at any time; your financial data and history are handed over on request in a usable format. The record belongs to the syndicate, not to us.

No. Immevia is a management tool. The syndicate’s obligations (Civil Code, declaration of co-ownership, Bill 16 and its regulations) remain its own; the platform helps organize them, document them and not miss their deadlines.
